criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Management
categories.definition: Queries related to ordering, activating, replacing, blocking, unblocking, or general usage of physical and virtual cards, including PIN management and delivery status.

categories.name: Fraud & Security
categories.definition: Queries about suspicious transactions, lost/stolen cards or phones, unauthorized access, or needing to freeze/block a card.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Queries related to opening, closing, updating personal details, or general information about the account itself (not specific to cards or transactions).

categories.name: Money Transfers
categories.definition: Queries about sending or receiving money, transfer status, delays, cancellations, or issues with transfers.

categories.name: Top-up & Add Funds
categories.definition: Queries about adding money to an account or card, including methods, limits, fees, and issues with top-ups.

categories.name: ATM & Cash Services
categories.definition: Queries specifically about ATM withdrawals, cash deposits, issues with ATMs (e.g., wrong amount, card declined), or cash-related services.

categories.name: Fees, Charges & Refunds
categories.definition: Queries about unexpected fees, charges, pending transactions, or missing refunds for known transactions.

categories.name: Currency Exchange & Holdings
categories.definition: Queries about exchanging currencies, holding money in different currencies, or exchange rates.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Queries about the process, requirements, or issues with verifying identity or source of funds.

categories.name: App & Technical Support
categories.definition: Queries about general app functionality or technical issues not covered by other categories.

categories.name: General Information / Support
categories.definition: General inquiries about the banking service, policies, or information not covered by other specific categories.
